response.original_title: The Guy Who Didn't Like Musicals: Reprised!
response.overview: Paul can't stand musicals, it's his greatest hate. But one day, he wakes up to find his town infectiously singing and dancing. As an alien presence takes Hatchetfield, Paul and a small group of survivors try to fight their way out.
response.title: The Guy Who Didn't Like Musicals: Reprised!
